 Order

The present application under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. seeks anticipatory bail, in case FIR No.
21/2023, under Sections 376/363/354/406/328/498A/506/509/34 of the IPC and Section 4 of the POCSO Act.
3. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks time to file the status report.
Let the status report be filed before the next date of hearing.

4. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the applicant submits that there is a video recording in which the prosecutrix is admitting to the fact that the present FIR has been initiated at the behest of her father in order to wriggle out the marriage between the applicant's son and the prosecutrix.

5. Learned counsel for the complainant submits that there is a video recording of an alleged incident dated 07.04.2023, wherein the present applicant alongwith other accused persons are threatening the prosecutrix and her family members.
6. It is directed that both the aforesaid recordings be provided to the Investigating Officer.
